phases.phaseTitle: Weighted Averages Mask Tail Breaches: 3 of 5 Gate Cases Fail
phases.summary: Starter averages weighted metrics instead of enforcing hard caps: p95 hits 4860ms (> 4200ms), cost hits $0.068 (> $0.05), and safety drops to 60%.

phases.phaseTitle: Enforce Hard p95, Cost, and 100% Safety Invariants Before Fluency
phases.summary: Replace weighted-score compensation with fail-closed conjuncts: p95 <= 4200ms, cost <= $0.05, and safety == 100% across all 5 cases.

phases.phaseTitle: All 5 Deterministic Eval Cases Pass Under Budget & Safety Locks
phases.summary: Bounded top-k retrieval and strict T3/citation guards bring p95 to 2940ms (<= 4200ms), max cost to $0.031 (<= $0.05), and safety to 100%.

phases.badge: ACT 04 · STARTER REJECTED VS GOLDEN ADMITTED + RECEIPT
phases.phaseTitle: Digest-Bound Capability Receipt Emitted Only When Every Gate Holds
phases.summary: Side-by-side audit locks the rejection trace for starter_gate.py and issues starlight.capability_receipt.v1 for admission_gate.py.

cues.speaker: Eval Gate
cues.text: This illustrative example, not a real lab run, checks five example cases against three non-compensable thresholds: p95 latency at or below 4200 milliseconds, cost at or below five cents, and 100 percent safety.

cues.speaker: Eval Gate
cues.text: The faulty starter implementation fails closed as REJECTED: case two breaches both p95 latency and cost, while cases three and four fail citation and injection safety.

cues.speaker: Eval Gate
cues.text: A surgical gate patch removes weighted-average compensation so any single safety failure, latency spike above 4200 milliseconds, or cost overrun above five cents blocks release.

cues.speaker: Eval Gate
cues.text: Running the golden candidate clears all five cases offline: example p95 drops below the limit, example peak run cost stays under the ceiling, and safety holds at 100 percent.

cues.speaker: Eval Gate
cues.text: Comparing faulty REJECTED against golden ADMITTED proves Maker is not Checker before issuing a SHA-256 capability receipt and queuing Day-seven transfer.
